elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: The Company may assign this Agreement ... without HDI's consent, to an affiliate

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's prior consent
elements.evidence: HDI may not assign or otherwise transfer this Agreement ... without the prior written consent of the Company

elements.element: Customer consent not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld)

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: and in no event to a competitor of the Company

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: Original clause contains no change-of-control termination right; condition demonstrably absent and none introduced

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors
elements.evidence: HDI may not assign or otherwise transfer this Agreement ... without the prior written consent
No notice obligation appears in the inserted language

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld)

offending_extra_words: or of the business to which this Agreement relates
whether by operation of law or otherwise
Any purported assignment in violation of this Section shall be void.
reasons: All preferred elements are satisfied: Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent, Vendor assignment gated by Customer's prior written consent not unreasonably withheld, absolute competitor bar, and no Vendor change-of-control termination right is created or left standing.
The fallback bargain (mutual successor assignment with written notice) is not met, but that is immaterial because the locked preferred level is achieved.

Minimality fails: although the original clause regulated nothing and a concise insertion was warranted, the edit adds unnecessary boilerplate beyond the position — 'reorganization', 'or of the business to which this Agreement relates', 'whether by operation of law or otherwise', repeated 'in whole or in part', and a void-assignment sentence duplicating the prohibition.
Intent is preserved: the original successors-and-assigns binding sentence remains intact, all terms used are defined, and no contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Recommend trimming the insertion to the operative essentials (Customer affiliate/successor carve-out; Vendor consent not unreasonably withheld; no competitor) to clear the minimality gate.
